flows:
Navigate to https://asana.com/ then Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog.
Use only its listed roles, names and controls.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it."
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
In Reading view, first assert a Product or Features link row is present.
Activate Product and verify a product overview page or menu is available.
Stop before signup.

remark: assert: a Product or Features link row is present in Reading view
click: Clicking Products in the top navigation row
analyze: a product overview menu is available
assert: a product overview page or menu is available

summary:
